name: pixiaoka/orm
description: Annotation-driven Active Record ORM for PHP 8.3+. Zero framework dependency. PDO based. Supports composite primary keys, strict type casting at the boundary, dirty tracking, lifecycle hooks, row cache, transactions, coroutine-safe sessions.

suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Running the test suite without external databases (in-memory SQLite)
suggest.ext-bcmath: PHP 8.4+ can wrap BcMath\Number with a one-line adapter implementing Pixiaoka\Orm\Cast\Decimal
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: For PostgreSQL connections (INSERT ... RETURNING is used to refill generated keys)
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: For MySQL connections (generated keys are refilled via lastInsertId)
